Proven ability to architect robust security architectures that align with regulatory compliance and business scalability. Consistently driven by measurable outcomes, such as reducing breach response times and improving encryption standards across distributed systems. Collaborative mindset with a focus on cross-team alignment and long-term security hygiene.
